video:video.video:title: What You Don't See Behind the Walls
video:video.video:description: Behind every finished room is framing, rough in, and careful work you rarely see on reveal day. This HomeCore Construction Reel walks through the stages that make a renovation last.

video:video.video:title: Kitchen Designed to Work Beautifully
video:video.video:description: A kitchen should be more than a beautiful space. This HomeCore Construction renovation was designed to work for everyday living, with clean cabinetry, a generous island, and a layout that feels open and practical.

video:video.video:title: Driveway Built from the Ground Up
video:video.video:description: A driveway built from the ground up. This HomeCore Construction hardscape Reel shows how stone pavers and a solid base come together for a finish that lasts.

video:video.video:title: In Progress Home Renovation POV
video:video.video:description: POV: Itll look better later. A quick look at a HomeCore Construction crew mid renovation as debris comes out and the structure takes shape.

video:video.video:title: Bridgehampton Custom Home Walkthrough
video:video.video:description: An in progress walkthrough of a HomeCore Construction custom home in Bridgehampton. From the foyer through framed rooms toward the backyard, you can already see how the spaces connect.

video:video.video:title: Kitchen Before and After Renovation
video:video.video:description: From the original space to the finished kitchen. This HomeCore Construction before and after shows how a thoughtful renovation creates a practical, cohesive room built with care.

video:video.video:title: Bridgehampton Kitchen Design Walkthrough
video:video.video:description: A kitchen designed around function and connection in our Bridgehampton custom home. This walkthrough covers the planned large island, white oak finishes, storage, a coffered ceiling, and the open link to the great room and backyard.

video:video.video:title: Custom Millwork Craftsmanship
video:video.video:description: Good craftsmanship starts long before the finished product. This HomeCore Construction Reel shows precision cutting and custom millwork that become cabinetry and interior details built to last.

video:video.video:title: Bridgehampton Bedrooms and Ensuite Baths
video:video.video:description: A walkthrough of bedrooms and ensuite bathrooms in our Bridgehampton custom home.

video:video.video:title: Bridgehampton Master Suite Design Walkthrough
video:video.video:description: A master suite designed with comfort, space, and natural light in mind in our Bridgehampton custom home.

video:video.video:title: Custom Home Framing and Structure
video:video.video:description: Every great home starts long before the finishing touches. From steel reinforcement beneath the structure to the timber framing that shapes each space.

video:video.video:title: Bridgehampton Build Walkthrough On Site
video:video.video:description: On site at our Bridgehampton custom home. A HomeCore Construction partner walks the framed interiors and talks through the scale of the build.

video:video.video:title: A Fresh Start Kitchen Renovation
video:video.video:description: Sometimes all you need is a fresh start. A HomeCore Construction look at a bright, updated kitchen.

video:video.video:title: A Great Finish Starts with Preparation
video:video.video:description: A great finish starts with preparation. This HomeCore Construction Reel shows careful interior prep under a window and wainscot work before the finished look comes together.

video:video.video:title: Long Island Custom Home Build Story
video:video.video:description: Long Island homeowners, this is what a full transformation looks like. HomeCore Construction reframed, underpinned, and added on to build a lasting custom home.

video:video.video:title: Fresh Navy Shutters Long Island Curb Appeal
video:video.video:description: Fresh paint, navy shutters. Prep comes first, then our crew brushes the shutters by hand for a clean, crisp finish against the white siding.

video:video.video:title: Inside the HomeCore Construction Mill Shop
video:video.video:description: Step inside the HomeCore Construction mill shop. Every custom cabinet, bookshelf and door we install is built right here in house, including solid mahogany doors made to last a hundred years.

video:video.video:title: Radiant Floor Heat Before the Slab Pour
video:video.video:description: Radiant floor heat starts with careful layout. On this HomeCore Construction custom home build on Long Island, we tie the tubing to the mesh over the slab before the pour, keeping even spacing so the finished floor delivers comfortable, even heat room to room.

video:video.video:title: Oakdale Ranch Remodel Walkthrough
video:video.video:description: Out in Oakdale, New York, HomeCore Construction is turning a large ranch from a dark, commercial feel into something warm and contemporary, with new flooring, paint, baseboards, doors, and lighting throughout.

video:video.video:title: Custom Home Master Suite Walkthrough on Long Island
video:video.video:description: Upstairs in the master suite of this HomeCore Construction custom home build on Long Island: an 11x12 master bath, a 10 by 10 walk in closet, and a framed tray ceiling, on the addition we built after underpinning the basement.

video:video.video:title: 5 Things Years in Construction Teach You
video:video.video:description: The longer you're in construction, the more you realize quality starts long before the finishing touches. This HomeCore Construction Short walks through framing, window flashing and house wrap with five lessons from years on the job.
